transfers.title: Stock transfers
transfers.subtitleHeadOffice: Head Office: approve requisitions, write transfer notes and dispatch.
transfers.subtitleBranch: Ask Head Office for stock and count what arrives.

itemPicker.placeholder: Search an item by name or code…

requisitions.searchToAdd: Search an item above to add it.
requisitions.approveHint: You can lower a quantity (0 leaves the item out). You cannot approve more than was asked.
requisitions.approvedToast: Requisition {docNo} approved. Write the transfer note next
requisitions.noteWrittenToast: Transfer note {docNo} written as a draft. Review it in Transfers, then dispatch
requisitions.noteFailed: Could not write the transfer note

list.savedToast: Transfer note {docNo} saved as a draft. Open it to dispatch
list.transitHeadOffice: Dispatched from Head Office and not yet received by the branch. These goods are in nobody’s stock.
list.transitBranch: Dispatched to this branch. Open a transfer and count it to add the goods to your stock.

detail.dispatchedToast: Transfer {docNo} dispatched. The goods are in transit

receiveDialog.title: Receive {docNo}
receiveDialog.intro: From {from}. Count what is in front of you. Good units go into your stock with the same batch and expiry. Damaged and short units are written off and never enter your stock.
receiveDialog.smallestUnit: Quantities are in the smallest unit (for example tablets).
receiveDialog.noteLabel: Note (for example what happened to damaged goods)
receiveDialog.lossNotice: {damaged} damaged and {short} short will be recorded as a loss at cost.
receiveDialog.doneToastLoss: Transfer {docNo} received: {received} added to stock, {damaged} damaged and {short} short recorded as a loss

form.title: New transfer note
form.costHint: Goods are sent at batch cost. Nothing leaves your stock until you dispatch the note.
form.saveFailed: Could not save the transfer note

rec.costRightNote: Values at cost are shown to users with the cost right.
rec.movementsMismatch: Movements on another branch's or item's batch
rec.historyNote: History is never edited. A problem is corrected with a stock adjustment, a return or a recount.
rec.syncNote: Figures come from the documents on this computer. A receipt reaches Head Office after the branch syncs, so Head Office can show goods as in transit until then.
rec.totalsLine: dispatched {dispatched} · received {received} · in transit {inTransit} · damaged {damaged} · short {short}
rec.truncated: Only the newest 2000 transfers are shown. Narrow the dates.
rec.noneInRange: No dispatched transfers in this range.

branches.title: Branches
branches.subtitleHeadOffice: Every branch of the organisation. Head Office sets item prices and tax rates for all of them.
branches.subtitleBranch: The branches of this organisation. They are managed by Head Office.
branches.dialogIntro: This adds the branch to the organisation and creates a one-time code for the branch PC. It needs the internet. If the branch already exists here and has not joined yet, this creates a new code for it.
branches.validUntil: Valid until {date} and works once. It is not shown again.
branches.step1: Install Mediescare on the branch PC and open it.
branches.step4: Enter the code above, then your name, a username and a password.
branches.step5: Keep the PC online until the first copy of items and suppliers is finished.
